description.value: Water Behind the Lock: Objective: restore emergency water. Bypass the contract or secure a public override; delay floods the clinic road.
The Wrong Name: Objective: locate the original patient. Follow receipts or interview the lobby nurse; delay starts a forced transfer.
A Train for the Missing: Objective: contact Juno. Trace the announcement or enter the maintenance tram; delay closes the tunnel.
Live Copper: Objective: make repairs safe. Isolate the transformer or reroute families; delay burns the roof bridge.
The Paper Vault: Objective: preserve consent evidence. Escort the auditor or copy originals under witness; delay triggers erasure.
Garden of Sleepers: Objective: protect shelter while pursuing the signal. Reroute drones or negotiate relocation; delay destroys the pump.
The Meter Auction: Objective: stop seizure. Prove sabotage or redeem the disputed transformer; delay sells household profiles.
A Body in the Ward: Objective: free patients without denying others care. Verify identities or secure neutral treatment; delay locks the ward.
Two Farewells: Objective: establish Juno's wishes. Compare physical records or mediate the branches; delay lets the collector copy them.
The Repair Bargain: Objective: secure sustainable power. Form a mutual or accept a bounded equipment contract; delay drains reserves.
Names on the Receipt: Objective: expose the exchange safely. Redact intimate data or protect public witnesses; delay reaches the insurer.
The Moving Tram: Objective: recover possessions and a return path. Start the tram or open a service gate; delay seals the carriage.
Hearing in the Rain: Objective: settle liability. Present anonymous outage evidence or seek a tenants' injunction; delay authorizes seizure.
The Clinic Injunction: Objective: stop further sales. Certify originals or bring the patient to testify; delay moves the ledger offsite.
A Boundary for Juno: Objective: record explicit consent. Preserve one branch or honor an end to copying; delay merges the recordings.
Who Owns the Water: Objective: choose repair governance. Sign a community deed or a limited lease; record who can cut power.
Names After Glass: Objective: settle restitution. Restore identities or fund private care; record whose evidence remains public.
Laststop at Dawn: Objective: decide the archive's future. Establish a consent trust or erase copies after farewell; record where sleepers can stay.
Pump Lockout: the intake shuts while the utility advertises priority access.
Borrowed Voice: a terminal greets the crew with a missing patient's name.
Arrival Announcement: the abandoned station repeats Juno's unfinished message.
Debt Notice: repair volunteers receive seizure orders before the public hearing.
Witness Transfer: the clinic moves the only original signatory into isolation.
Camp Inspection: maintenance drones order sleepers to leave without another shelter.
Roof Surge: a faulty bridge wire sparks beside a medicine runner.
Receipt Leak: a broker offers evidence in exchange for deleting one buyer's name.
Branch Dispute: two copies disagree about whether the courier wanted rescue.
Transformer Auction: the district's spare unit goes on sale during the flood.
Ward Alarm: patients panic when their borrowed names stop receiving care.
Garden Blackout: a signal test threatens the camp's only water pump.
Public Hearing: the utility demands personal meter records as proof of sabotage.
Backup Erasure: auditors have minutes before the original consent scan disappears.
False Farewell: an advertisement repeats a stolen intimate memory.
Contract Confession: the foreman offers testimony if their crew receives amnesty.
Patient Escape: a name seal frees one patient but locks another out.
Track Closure: the tram route will be demolished at sunrise.
Repair Offer: a corporation offers free equipment in exchange for perpetual data access.
Clinic Injunction: an advocate can halt sales if the crew preserves the originals.
Sibling Arrival: Ren arrives with a farewell that contradicts the signal.
Roof Council: tenants debate who should hold the emergency override.
Buyer Threat: an insurer threatens to cancel innocent patients' treatment.
Anchor Failure: the coherent courier branch begins losing its last journey.
Power Shared: a neighboring block offers cells if its own outage is acknowledged.
Exchange Hearing: the court offers restitution without restoring every stolen name.
Camp Vote: sleepers demand a say in moving the memory trust.
Open Intake: the crew's ownership decision changes who controls emergency water.
Names Returned: patients choose between privacy, testimony and compensation.
Final Departure: Juno asks the crew to record their chosen boundary before the train leaves.
